metadata.case_name: Post-Soviet Divergence: Estonia vs Russia vs Ukraine
metadata.author: transcribed from live/runs by expansion agent
metadata.key_test: P1 ordinal prediction across the post-Soviet floor: highest pre-event P1 (Estonia) should achieve the best trajectory; high human capital / resource wealth should NOT rescue a floor-P1 state (Russia).
metadata.notes: USSR dissolution into 15 successor states (engineered/imperial dissolution). Pre-event 1996. All 1996 pillar values are ordinal estimates from the run; precise 1996 WGI percentiles were not isolated from primary tables. WGI 2025-anchored revised series used where available (recalculated back to 1996); both legacy (-2.5..+2.5) and revised series preserve the orderings used here.

pre_event.event_description: Dissolution of the USSR into 15 successor states; divergent post-Soviet modernization trajectories under structural stress.

context.neighbor_details: Borders Russia but on the integrative (EU/NATO) trajectory by the post-event window.

Estonia.notes: 1996 estimate (ordinal): P1 high (~0.45-0.55 on 0-1), P4 moderate-high, P5 moderate -> MI ~= 0.40 (matches dataset 0.398). Configuration: balanced, institution-led; narrowest pillar spread of the post-Soviet three. WGI Rule of Law / Govt Effectiveness / Control of Corruption / Regulatory Quality all highest of the three (clear regional reformer). HDI 1995 ~0.79 band; GDP per cap PPP 1996 highest of three. ERCAS describes Estonia as 'since 1991, the world's most successful short transition to good governance.' Pillar values are estimates, not exact WGI; WGI 2025-anchored vintage caveat applies.

context.neighbor_details: Itself the predatory regional power (Safeguard D) toward lower-P1 neighbors such as Ukraine.

data_sources.cpi: Transparency International CPI (1996/1998, cross-country ordinal only)

Russia.notes: 1996 estimate (ordinal): P1 very low (~0.10), P4 distorted by resource rents (rentier flag, Safeguard E), P5 low -> MI ~= 0.09 (dataset 0.087). Configuration: rentier, widest spread of the three (high human capital vs floor institutions). WGI Rule of Law / Control of Corruption bottom tier / very low. CPI 1996/1998 ~2.4 (very corrupt). HDI 1995 ~0.77 band; GDP per cap PPP 1996 middle; natural-resource rents high (oil/gas rentier flag). Pillar values are estimates, not exact WGI; CPI ~2.4 is approximate and from 1996/1998 (pre-2012 CPI not year-comparable, ordinal cross-country use only) so left null in indicators. WGI 2025-anchored vintage caveat applies.

context.neighbor_details: Low-P1 state bordering an aggressive power (Russia); Safeguard D -> elevated catastrophic-downside risk. 2014 annexation, 2022 invasion.

data_sources.cpi: Transparency International CPI (1998, cross-country ordinal only)

Ukraine.notes: 1996 estimate (ordinal): P1 low (~0.12), P4 weak, P5 low -> MI ~= 0.12 (dataset 0.119). Configuration: uniformly weak, no rentier cushion. WGI Rule of Law bottom tier (~ Russia). CPI 1998 = 2.8, then declining. HDI 1995 ~0.74 band; GDP per cap PPP 1996 lowest of three; resource rents moderate; political stability moderate. Democratic aspirations + weak P4 -> high reversal/instability risk (Safeguard C). Pillar values are estimates, not exact WGI; CPI is 1998 (not 1996) and pre-2012 (ordinal use only) so left null in indicators. WGI 2025-anchored vintage caveat applies.

a_trajectory_ranking.prediction: Estonia best trajectory; Estonia > Russia ~ Ukraine.
a_trajectory_ranking.basis: Highest pre-event P1 (Estonia clear regional reformer); Russia and Ukraine both near the institutional floor.
a_trajectory_ranking.falsification_condition: Russia or Ukraine matches or exceeds Estonia's trajectory.

b_violence.prediction: Estonia peaceful/integrative; Russia internally stable but externally aggressive; Ukraine highest violence exposure.
b_violence.agency_note: Mod8: this predicts RISK, not AGENCY
b_violence.falsification_condition: Violence concentrates in Estonia rather than in the low-P1 cases.

c_convergence.prediction: Divergence (Estonia pulls away; Russia and Ukraine stay low).
c_convergence.basis: Wide pre-event P1 gap between Estonia and the other two.

d_failure_dimension.prediction: Estonia succeeds on P1/institutions; Russia fails on P1 despite high human capital; Ukraine fails on P1 plus predatory-neighbor exposure.
d_failure_dimension.note: Most exposed to post-hoc coding bias
d_failure_dimension.falsification_condition: Outcomes driven by a non-P1 dimension.

e_fragment_count.prediction: 15 USSR successors = engineered (imperial dissolution, not organic state formation); high fragment count plus mostly low P1 -> heterogeneous, mostly difficult outcomes (only the Baltics thrive).
e_fragment_count.falsification_condition: Fragmentation reads as organic, or low-P1 successors broadly thrive.

f_reversal_risk.prediction: Ukraine reversal risk HIGH (democratic aspirations + weak P4).
f_reversal_risk.falsification_condition: Ukraine sustains a stable upward democratic trajectory.

Estonia.outcome_summary: Steepest and highest trajectory; EU/NATO/eurozone integration. P1 2024 = 0.865.

Russia.outcome_summary: Flat-but-stable M (rents buy stability in a low-P1 state); never modernizes. P1 2024 = 0.278.

Ukraine.outcome_summary: Absolute decline post-2012 (0.177 -> 0.143); subjected to invasion. P1 2024 = 0.387.

a_trajectory.explanation: Highest pre-event P1 produced the best trajectory, as predicted.

b_violence.evidence: Estonia peaceful; Ukraine subjected to invasion.
b_violence.explanation: Violence concentrated in the low-P1 case (Ukraine), not in high-P1 Estonia.

c_convergence.evidence: Gap widened from 0.31 to 0.51 (Estonia vs Russia).

d_failure_dimension.explanation: Estonia succeeded on the institutional pillar; Russia/Ukraine failed on P1 as predicted. [STRICT RE-CODE per run6 §3(d): post-hoc 'primary dimension' identification invites confirmation bias; coded PARTIAL under strict standards.]

e_fragment_count.evidence: Engineered count 'defensible but the framework is directional, not a fragment-count oracle; coded conservatively.'
e_fragment_count.explanation: The engineered-dissolution call is supported in aggregate (only the Baltics thrived) but the framework is directional, not a fragment-count oracle.

f_reversal_risk.evidence: 2024 M below 1996-trajectory expectation; absolute decline post-2012.
f_reversal_risk.explanation: Ukraine's high reversal risk (Safeguard C) was borne out (Orange Revolution reversal, 2014, war).

g_suppression.explanation: No suppression-mechanism prediction was made for this case.

h_turbulence.explanation: No sub-state turbulence (Safeguard F) prediction was made for this case.

result_coding_reference.CONFIRMED: Prediction matched outcome on the specific dimension predicted
result_coding_reference.PARTIALLY_CONFIRMED: Direction correct but magnitude, form, or timing significantly different
result_coding_reference.NOT_APPLICABLE: Prediction type not relevant to this case
result_coding_reference.coding_rule: When ambiguous between confirmed and partial, code PARTIAL. When ambiguous between partial and falsified, code PARTIAL but note ambiguity.

analysis.overall_assessment: Strong directional confirmation: 5 of 6 applicable predictions CONFIRMED, 1 PARTIAL, none falsified. The framework cleanly separates 'high human capital + floor institutions' (Russia) from 'institution-led modernization' (Estonia), vindicating the 34% P1 weight.
new_failure_modes_discovered: High P3/P4 (human capital, resource wealth) can hold a low-P1 state stable for decades without modernizing it; the framework predicts the non-improvement, not the regime durability.
analysis.what_this_case_uniquely_reveals: Russia exposes a limitation/strength of the framework: it correctly predicts non-improvement of a floor-P1 rentier state but says nothing about its decades-long durability. Estonia confirms institution-led modernization at the post-Soviet top.
analysis.baseline_impact: None; no modification proposed. Reinforces P1-ordinal as the validated core.
analysis.strict_recode_note: Strict re-code applied per run6 (post-hoc d-dimension -> PARTIAL; narrow-gap a-trajectory annotated with Mod4). Honest aggregate target ~62-78%.
